Your holdings: SOXL (-51.65%) and SPAL (-39.28%) are both leveraged ETFs showing significant losses and are flagged "SELL" or "NEW." These are your most pressing concerns, especially with margin amplifying drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on any signs of profit-taking in the broader tech/AI sector after these big moves. Also, monitor your leveraged positions closely for further decay or downside.

Bottom line: Ride the AI wave carefully, but prioritize managing the outsized risk in your leveraged, underperforming positions.
